title: MIMI reference implementation v1
description: Rust reference implementation of IETF MIMI over MLS (RFC 9420) on OpenMLS 0.9.1 (extensions-draft, small local patch), plus enough product around it to be usable. Goals: (a) MIMI interop/reference target and (b) usable chat system (mimid-1wgh product-scope memory). Implements latest drafts as written: mimi-arch-03, mimi-protocol-06, mimi-content-09, mimi-room-policy-04, mls-extensions-10, mls-ratchet-tree-options-01 (AppSync read as AppDataUpdate; SemiPrivateMessage deferred). Components: spec-only crates (mimi-mls, mimi-content, mimi-room-policy, mimi-protocol); one mimid server binary (hub + follower roles, provider JMAP Chat endpoint, admin CLI); mimid-agent local daemon (MLS on device, plaintext JMAP Chat on a unix socket); thin TUI (adapted kith-tui). Client-provider API: JMAP Chat E2EE subset + mimid MLS capability. In v1: attachments (+OHTTP). Out of v1: identity/portability drafts, spaces, room directory, history on new devices, abuse enforcement, PQ suites, GUI. Specs: ~/PROJECT/IETF/specs. Decisions: closed decision-type children of this epic.
